scope: Cursor Agent-like sidebar new-chat retention, real archive/delete state transitions, and non-destructive interaction checks
userFinding: Creating a new chat made the old chat disappear from the left sidebar.

observed: Cursor Agent keeps multiple previous chats visible under the same repository after New Agent.
Visible historical rows expose Pin and Archive actions; draft rows expose Discard/Delete-like cleanup.
Project groups keep See more expansion for older rows without hiding recent historical chats behind default drafts.

actions: Clicked the current project New Agent control.
Verified old conversation rows remained visible in p1 after the new draft was created.
Searched for an existing chat title and confirmed search returns retained visible history plus deleted history.
Clicked Show more and verified hidden draft rows expand without removing visible retained history.

Reloaded an isolated 127.0.0.1 app tab after the runtime export compatibility fix and confirmed the sidebar renders New Agent, Automations, Customize, Search, Repositories, per-project New Agent, Settings, and the active chat area without Vite export errors.
observedRowsAfterFix: Retained historical chats appear before default draft rows.
Retained rows expose Archive chat and Delete chat actions, not Restore chat.
Only the current empty draft is rendered as a draft row; inactive default drafts from other scenarios no longer push real history behind Show more.
Explicit archived/deleted rows remain out of the main Repositories list.

implementation: New chat now retains the previous active session as normal sidebar history instead of marking it archived.
Legacy sessions archived by the old new-chat path are treated as retained history when their latest reason matches the old new-chat archive reason.
The main sidebar renders active current threads, retained history, then drafts, so default drafts cannot push old chats out of the first page.
Explicit Archive/Delete can operate on retained history without touching the current draft.
Archived settings and workbench archived counts exclude retained sidebar history.
The browser runtime UI imports the shared runtime contract through the package root so Vite can load the dev page while node package exports are stale for the browser-runtime subpath.
remainingRisk: Delete and Archive clicks on retained rows were verified through focused state/DOM tests rather than destructive browser clicks on the user's live chats.
A fully isolated writer-backed seeded workspace is still the preferred place to perform live destructive Archive/Delete clicks end to end.
